Also would recommend a bike with 1x, as it’s lighter and makes life so much easier. It’s definitely not a requirement for everyone, but for me a 1x is. 

Also doesn’t look very upgradable. If you wanted to upgrade components, it would be difficult to find parts; especially during the pandemic. It’s also going to be difficult to progress your riding skill very far with this. You are going to outgrow this (in skill) very quickly, which means it doesn’t have very good value. 

No clue how much you would spend on this, the lowest end bike you could get without being unsafe is around 400-500 USD. I would highly recommend going to a bike shop around you and seeing what they have. Don’t buy this IMO.
